name: Europe hybrid attacks
summary: Supermarket refrigeration attacks hit stores in several EU states; no claim or attribution
state: Cyberattacks on 2 Nov caused fridges and freezers to fail at more than 100 shops in several EU countries, including Belgium, Luxembourg, Sweden and Ireland; Belgian prosecutors opened a criminal investigation and the EU agriculture commissioner called it a deliberate attempt to disrupt food supply (Al Jazeera, 3 Nov). Nobody has claimed the attacks and no state has been formally blamed.
for_you: Food safety is not reported at risk; follow shop and Food Standards Agency advice if products are withdrawn.
rubric_hit: Cross-border sabotage of food retail, unattributed = Watch
